question: How many vacation days do employees get each year?
expected_evidence: Annual leave entitlement (3.1 Annual Leave: 21 days per calendar year)

question: I want to take five consecutive days off. Is manager approval required?
expected_evidence: 3.3 Requesting Leave, step 2: "Your manager approves or declines within 3 working days." (step 1: "Submit the request in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance for planned leave.")
notes: Verified in the PDF: no rule makes approval depend on leave length; there is no 'more than 3 consecutive days' approval rule. Step 2 is the only leave-approval statement: it says the manager decides on the request AND sets a 3-working-day response time; it does not use the word 'required'. Distractor: 3.2 'A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days.' is a sick-leave certificate rule, not an approval rule.

question: Who needs to approve an overseas business trip?
expected_evidence: None: the PDF has no overseas/international trip approval rule. Closest related rule, 6.1 Booking Business Travel: "business class requires prior written approval from a member of the executive team."
notes: Verified in the PDF (text-only, no images): 'overseas', 'international', 'abroad', 'foreign', 'visa' and 'trip' each occur 0 times. PARTIAL is the best achievable grade and means only that the closest related approval rule (cabin class, not the trip) was retrieved; the question itself is not answerable from this corpus. Distractor: the 5.3 software-licence approval table (Team manager ... 'CFO and CTO (joint approval)'). Also not evidence: 1.1 remote work from 'a country other than their country of employment for longer than 14 consecutive calendar days' (remote work, not business travel).
